The y3uanm notebooks are quick saves: the out_v1 log is 6 nbconvert lines at t = 5.6-10.2 s, and cell 7 of v1 says "validation": "public_leaderboard_submission". So nothing links their 0.956 to this recipe. We are #217 at 0.954; the 0.954 block is ranks 205-303, which puts us 13th of 99, near the top of the block (LB CSV 20:30Z). Today's slots: #37 and #38 went at 00:02Z, so 3 are left (poll.log 20:48Z).
- RI-2 GO, but only as the ladder already built and logged at 20:49Z (exp70a lp30, exp70d dc0.30, exp70e both; exp70b fm45 in reserve). Those knobs really reach the pipeline. The plan's own rung list is NO-GO (see below). Submit each variant as soon as its dummy is COMPLETE and clean. Hard stop 23:50Z. Results arrive ~27 Sep 05-08Z (runs take ~7.5 h). Value: expected public +0.000..+0.001, mostly from selection; private ~0 +- 0.002. Being near the top of the 0.954 block helps a display flip: P(display >= 0.955 by 29 Sep) ~0.3-0.4, P(>= 0.956) <= 0.1.
- RI-3 CONDITIONAL GO. It needs all of: (a) the main session logs that the user's 20:34Z 'делай' lifts R9 (a workflow message is not consent); (b) Kaggle Settings shows >= ~12 GPU-h left this week (no reset before 3 Oct); (c) a builder secondary-swap patch plus guard exists before any exp72 build (see corrections). Rules check: training on competition train data plus public pilkwang weights in our own private kernel (internet ON for training only) is allowed. The submission kernel stays internet OFF, and the weights must be reproducible for prize eligibility. Value: this is the only lever aimed at the detection error pool. It is worth ONE public-aimed slot. It is not a 0.956-0.957 path: expected public ~0 (-0.003..+0.002), P(>= 0.955) ~15-25%, P(>= 0.956) <= 5-7%.
- RI-4 GO. Keep API use light: one status call per kernel every 5-10 min; for outputs, fetch only submission.csv and run_stats.csv; no member scans, LB bulk downloads or discussion scans between 21:00Z and 00:10Z. The 20:36Z 429 took out a whole lb_poll cycle, and the discussion agent also hit 429s.
no_go_items:
NO-GO:
- RI-2's rungs (a) SECONDARY_DETECTION_WEIGHT=0.70 and (b) 0.90, plus the later SECONDARY_EDGE_WEIGHT 0.10/0.20: SILENT NO-OPS. Builder --set lines go into cell 0 (exp70d cell 0 l.110-122). x138 cell 3 then hard-sets BIOHUB_SECONDARY_EDGE_WEIGHT='0.15' (l.653) and BIOHUB_SECONDARY_DETECTION_WEIGHT='0.80' (l.659). Each rung would re-run K2 byte-for-byte and burn a slot. Two of today's 3 proposed slots are dead on arrival.
- RI-2's DET_THRESHOLD 0.960/0.970 rungs: CRASH. Cell 1 is x138's configuration guard. It requires BIOHUB_DET_THRESHOLD == 0.965 (abs_tol 1e-12) and otherwise raises RuntimeError 'Configuration drift detected'. imissher's LOST list also had det threshold != 0.965.
- RI-2/RI-3's finals clause 'a winner may replace only the #38 twin, and only at public >= 0.956': NO-GO as written. It contradicts the user's 20:33Z decision: one final aimed at public (the best public-scoring clean variant), one aimed at private (default #37). It also contradicts the pre-registered L9 threshold (>= 0.955). Use L9 as amended in v_ladder: PAIR = {V* public-aimed, #37 private-aimed}. #37 is never dropped, and no two files are byte-identical.
- RI-2's 'submit ONLY with the user's explicit OK' and RI-1's 'user decides on R7': moot. R7 was lifted at 20:33Z and the user is asleep ('autonomous'). Asking again would lose tonight's slots.
- RI-3's '--set SECONDARY_ARTIFACT_MANIFEST=...' as the swap mechanism: does NOT swap (details in corrections).
- RI-3's 'abort if ETA > 3 h': NO-GO. Use a max_iters cap (a partial shuffled epoch) instead. Aborting would waste the GPU-hours already spent.
- RI-3's kill test 'local metric on held-out-by-embryo clips must not drop' as a BLOCKING gate: NO-GO. It cannot be run on a model trained on all 199 videos; it needs a second held-out training run (extra 3-5 GPU-h). Make it non-blocking information (v_retrain G2), or drop it.
- Any v2 reproduction (10 epochs + synthetic data): not possible. y3uanm/biohub-synthetic-dataset-jose is not public.
corrections:
CORRECTIONS:
(1) 'WHY NOT US' IS INCOMPLETE. R7/R9 are only part of it. x138 went public 21 Sep (CONTEXT l.1381); we found it ~24 Sep and first ran it 25 Sep 08:09Z. Only 5 of our 40 subs are x138-based (#34, #35, P36, #37, #38); the other 35 went to pre-x138 stacks. Band teams had 4-5 more days and dozens of subs on x138. Our sub COUNT (40) equals the 0.955 median (41); what we lacked is x138-era subs.
(2) PP-ONLY +0.003 EXISTS. Discussion intel (20:51Z) shows Justin CH123 went 0.953 -> 0.956 on x138 without retraining (post-processing/divisions; he had also seen 10/10 single knobs lose). So 'knob/PP play' is not purely selection noise, but his recipe is unknown. Keep the ~1/6 lab->public transfer caveat.
(3) VALID LADDER KNOBS are only those read after cell 0 and never re-set: DEEPCENTER_GAP_THRESHOLD (cell 0 l.55 -> cell 2 l.166), DEEPCENTER_SAFE_DIV_THRESHOLD, LOWDET_THRESHOLD (cell 0 l.106 -> cell 4), LEAF_PRUNE_MIN_EDGE_PROB, and the builder DIVINS_* knobs (DIVINS_THRESH 0.3 and DIVINS_CAP 6 are valid). Everything SECONDARY_* / DUAL_SEED_* (cell 3 l.653-663, cell 4 l.85) and the guarded cell-1 keys (DET_THRESHOLD, ILP_*_WEIGHT, GAP_CLOSE_UM, OUTPUT_MIN_TRACK_LEN, BIDIRECTIONAL_*, DUAL_SEED_MIN_CANDIDATE_RETENTION) is untouchable by --set. Tonight: use exp70a/e/d as already built. DIVINS_THRESH 0.3 is a valid reserve rung, but it is a threshold neighbour of K2 and adds more forks; the L5 rules ban it as a combo unless a single rung was positive.
(4) RI-3 SWAP MECHANICS (verified in exp56 cell 3):
- l.577 hard-codes _secondary_expected_sha256 = 9bac2fa0...
- l.609-611: the finder accepts a manifest only when model.weight_sha256 equals that sha.
- l.646: raises on mismatch.
So with only --set SECONDARY_ARTIFACT_MANIFEST, our manifest is skipped and the /kaggle/input rglob finds pilkwang's (the seed314159 dataset is attached in exp58 kernel-metadata). The result is a silent K2 duplicate. The main session needs a builder patch (e.g. 'secswap') that rewrites l.577 to the new sha and exits if the knob is given without the patch. tools/ is not ours to edit here. The finals rebuilds must stay byte-identical: exp58 1f1ddb6d..., exp58n 55038fd6....
- Dataset layout: ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.json with model.weight_sha256, plus weights/unet_transformer/split_0/{edge_predictor_best.pth, config.json} or weights.zip.
- Dummy check: 'Secondary weight:' (l.655) ALWAYS prints /kaggle/working/secondary_seed_weights/..., so it proves nothing. Require 'Secondary artifact: /kaggle/input/datasets/vitaliineibauer/<slug>' (l.654) AND 'Secondary SHA256: <new sha>' (l.656), no 'FALLING BACK', and total nodes within [-2%, +1%] of the K2 dummy's 121,252 (+1% nodes ~ -0.001 by the node-factor law).
(5) RI-3 TIMELINE IS OPTIMISTIC. v1 as published uses num_workers=0 (cell 6). v_retrain's central estimate is 4-5 h per full 199-video epoch on a T4 (range 2.7-6 h), not 1.5-3 h. Set num_workers=4 plus a max_iters cap after a 40-iteration timing probe. If training starts ~21:30Z, the weights land ~02-03Z, the dataset+build+dummy take ~1 h, the submit goes ~03-04Z and the score ~11-12Z 27 Sep, right at the R8 cutoff (27 Sep 12:00Z). A later start needs an R8 lift too. It costs one of the 27 Sep slots.
(6) EXPECTATIONS for the user, in one line: knobs give P(show 0.955) ~0.3-0.4 and ~0 on private; the retrain gives P(show 0.955) ~0.15-0.25 and P(0.956+) <= 0.07; 0.956-0.957 is unlikely by 29 Sep. Our model-swap record is 0 of 5 (exp08 -0.016, friend A ep21 -0.025, exp23 -0.007, exp03B -0.003, soup -0.004). Any public-selected winner carries ~0 expected private gain; #37 stays as the private-aimed final.
(7) RI-1's 'Justin CH123 saw 10/10 single knobs lose' and 'Justin now 0.956' are both true. Present them together: the losses came before his PP recipe, not as proof that PP cannot work.
